context: A teacher walks a teen through social research
purpose: Teach: 人道/倒す/信徒/激化/国税/紙幣/財界/原動力

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、論文、人道主義の歴史、丁寧に、扱っていますね、研究の質、本当に、高いです。
lines.en: Sakura — your paper on the history of humanism is handled so carefully. The research quality is genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, professorial approval. Measured pace. Slight lean forward, eyes steady on her work. Recognition without condescension.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史上、暴政を、倒す市民運動、複数、取り上げました、論文の中で。
lines.en: Yes. I focused on several civic movements throughout history that brought down tyranny — I covered a few in the paper.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Speaking from her notes but sincere. A student sharing what she actually discovered, not reciting.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 各宗教の信徒、社会に、果たした役割、論文で、丁寧に、扱われていますね、印象的でした。
lines.en: The way you handled the role different faiths played in society — that was quite striking. You gave it real depth.
lines.style: Genuinely engaged now. Slower, more reflective. She's noticing something real in the work, not just checking boxes. Slight nod.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。冷戦の激化、世界中の市民生活、深く、影響を、与えましたね、第三章で、論じました。
lines.en: Yes. The Cold War's intensification affected citizens' lives worldwide so deeply — I examined that in the third chapter.
lines.style: Steady, focused. Speaking with quiet confidence about her own thinking. Direct eye contact level. No rush.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国税制度の歴史、各国の社会構造、反映していますね、論文でも、扱いましたよね。
lines.en: The history of tax systems really does reflect each country's social structure, doesn't it. You tackled that well in your conclusion.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. She's connecting dots aloud. Genuine curiosity — not testing her, exploring together. Warm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。紙幣のデザイン、文化的象徴として、各国、こだわっていますね、興味深い研究テーマです。
lines.en: Right — the way each nation cares about currency design as cultural symbol. That's a really compelling research angle.
lines.style: Approving nod. Energized slightly — she found something original. Warm recognition. Speaking as someone who sees what this student is actually capable of.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後、財界の影響力、政治にも、及んできましたね、論文の終盤で、扱われていますね。
lines.en: And how post-war business leaders' influence extended into politics — you brought that out beautifully in the later sections.
lines.style: Reflective, almost admiring. Slower cadence. This is genuine praise, carefully weighted. She means every word.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。市民の声こそ、民主主義の、最大の原動力ですね、論文の結論として、書きました、本当に。
lines.en: That's exactly right. The citizen's voice is democracy's greatest driving force — and that's a strong note to end on.
lines.style: Affirming, gentle finality. A teacher recognizing when a student has found something true. Warm close. She's proud.
